name: Tata Steel (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Tata Steel (Thailand) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, distribution, and trading of steel bars, wire rods, and small section products in Thailand and internationally. The company was formerly known as Millennium Steel Public Company Limited and changed its name to Tata Steel (Thailand) Public Company Limited in December 2006. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Tata Steel (Thailand) Public Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of T S Global Holdings Pte Ltd.
